page.overview:
What is 0259-S?

After a brief fight, Thanos welcomed Silver Surfer to his garden. He told him that Warlock had entrusted him with the Reality Stone, which he had kept safe on this planet. However, a thief somehow had managed to steal it. Aware of the surfer's vast powers, Thanos asked for his aid in retrieving it from whomever had taken it.

In the MCU, Planet 0259-S, informally known as The Garden, was an otherwise uninhabited planet to which Thanos always planned to retire after completing his quest of balancing all life in the Universe. After completing his life goal, Thanos did in fact settle on Planet 0259-S to live as a simple farmer, but was murdered by Thor of the Avengers only 23 days later.
